primary_source.title: Co-teaching: Robust Training of Deep Neural Networks with Extremely Noisy Labels
primary_source.claim_boundary: The source motivates two networks exchanging small-loss examples when training labels are noisy. It does not establish label noise in P1, a P1 forget rate, or P1 performance.

semantic_fingerprint.candidate: two independently initialized causal probes; each mini-batch selects prospectively scheduled small-loss rows; each peer updates only on rows selected by the other peer
semantic_fingerprint.repository_search: No co-teaching, peer small-loss exchange, label-noise transition objective, or peer-loss execution was found in P1/P2/P3.
semantic_fingerprint.distinct_from_gce: v36 changes a single network's scalar loss; co-teaching changes data selection and exchanges rows between two networks.
semantic_fingerprint.distinct_from_focal: v38 downweights easy rows within one network; co-teaching keeps small-loss rows selected by the opposite network.
semantic_fingerprint.distinct_from_rdrop: v39 matches two stochastic passes of one model on the same row; co-teaching uses two model states and cross-peer row selection.

required: a documented reason that P1 training labels are corrupted rather than merely class-imbalanced
a label-free or externally documented estimate that prospectively fixes the forget rate
evidence that two-peer small-loss selection is identifiable for the small eight-unit probe
target_free_support_gate.reason: README documents ground-truth labels but supplies no corruption mechanism or target-free noise-rate proxy. Inspecting losses against labels to infer the hypothesis would itself consume target information before the support gate and would make the forget schedule outcome-dependent.

hypothetical_fit_accounting.reason: Both peer optimizers count as separate fits; 2 peers times 3 seeds equals 6 fits. The independent support gate fails, so none may run.

prohibitions: Do not infer a noise rate from P1 labels after this closure.
Do not import a forget rate from MNIST or CIFAR experiments.
Do not execute, retune, retry, rescue, or submit this family under the same scientific hypothesis.
